propositions: git stash push/pop/drop operations in the tickets worktree access a shared stash stack across all worktrees, causing foreign stashes created in other branches to be incorrectly applied into the tracker
unmerged index entries from foreign stashes (e.g., source files like src/ and .rebar/) strand the store in a state that blocks every ticket write until manual intervention
a standalone clone tracker with its own .git directory eliminates the shared stash stack hazard, while a linked worktree remains vulnerable
the auto-heal mechanism classifies conflicted paths as regenerable (.bridge_state/), ticket data, or foreign (not tracked on tickets branch) and discards foreign paths instead of wedging
push.py must replace stash push/pop/drop with git stash create (commit object only) followed by stash apply <sha>, ensuring only the operation's own commit is restored

rebar tracker-maintenance provides a supported, audited door for raw git mutations with backup refs, unpushed-commit guards, and break-glass override, eliminating operator need for ad-hoc git commands
